audit.input_rationale: BenchmarkRedactJSON before the fix (base redact.go through a Go overlay). Inputs are the whole task worktree at the reviewed head (hashed, nothing excluded, including the ignored web/node_modules, bin, and scripts/__pycache__ that the command does not read), the Go launcher at /usr/local/go, and the Go module cache at /home/user/go/pkg/mod, which holds the go1.24.0 toolchain that GOTOOLCHAIN=auto selects from go.mod and every resolved module. GOCACHE points at a fresh empty directory for each run, so no earlier build output is reused. The Make command is the repository's test-go target with its Go command overridden through RUN_GO_UNIT_TESTS, as the approved plan's step 5 directs. RUN_WEB_LINT is ':' and the six prerequisite targets are marked with -o, so the run executes only the focused go test command: those targets do not build or test internal/redact, and CI runs all of them at the same head. HOME is inventoried by fingerprint and the command reads no HOME configuration. The Go overlay at /home/user/.local/state/conveyor/261120-db3057/inputs/overlay.json replaces internal/redact/redact.go with base/redact.go, which is git show dc3fdccca9ce4a0770b0d925f94a20e38f0d059f:internal/redact/redact.go (sha256 d6d91227fba76aa31472bfbed6ba8efad78b6d9acf8f124fe0973f60f0bc3336), and hides internal/redact/redact_cache_test.go, which uses the new clock seam and does not compile against the base file. That directory is an external input.
